blocking_findings.finding: The malformed writes/state_fields loop mutates only f.request and calls lane_reject, while selected proof/dispatch.json still records original request. A Source implementation omitting canonical path/pointer checks can reject solely on authority mismatch and pass these purported structural checks. The owned proof records ../escape versus pinned src/a.py without executing an absent API.
blocking_findings.remedy: Keep explicit untrusted authority-override checks. Separately re-pin a consistently bound dispatch for each representable malformed path/pointer fixture so the target shape remains the sole defect; assert rejection and restore a valid request/authority followed by positive. Keep nonfinite/cycle data as setup-safe JSON rejection cases, not invented executable red. Include validly re-pinned current coordination identity/status/feature-phase predicates when testing those mandatory bindings, rather than relying only on stale raw-byte failure.

blocking_findings.finding: Positive inventory spans owned committed/staged/live/untracked/ignored changes, but negative inventory only adds untracked/ignored files. No new121 probe stages/commits an undeclared tracked change or rename, flips an undeclared attempt file mode, or creates a symlinked declared file/component. Feature-list mode drift tests the current snapshot interface and does not exercise attempt entry modes. There are also no unmerged/submodule/unsafe Git-mode attempt fixtures despite explicit isolation predicates.
blocking_findings.remedy: Within existing five selectors, add owned scratch actual Git probes for undeclared staged and committed changes; rename endpoints crossing ownership; mode-only undeclared change; declared path/file symlink; and unmerged/submodule or other unsafe entry modes required by the approved isolation profile. Re-pin otherwise consistent authority and use exact valid base/root; require denial before effects and restored positive inventory after each independent defect. Preserve the genuine positive mixed inventory.

blocking_findings.finding: After capturing failure for the original owned attempt, root-loop calls f.authorize(attempt_root=root) but leaves rollback_ref bound to the original root. Main/shared/ancestor/nested/alias/foreign probes can all reject only on failure-record root mismatch. An implementation lacking a root/removal guard can therefore pass those broad rejections. Own fixture proof confirms the new alias request and retained failure reference name different roots.
blocking_findings.remedy: For each unsafe root probe, independently pin an otherwise matching failure record whose root/owner/base/attempt/operation equal the selected request and authority; keep actual nonzero capture semantics. Require the root/isolation defect to deny removal with files/registration unchanged. Restore original valid request/dispatch/failure and prove valid isolation between probes before the final one owned rollback. Retain separate deliberately mismatched-proof cases.
